_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-13. CardID = 17600 + idx; 349 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 49). The deck object (ea91d3) holds 31 cards: the 30 plus the character card. Same sheet number as Medusa, the turtles and the other sheet-176 decks: only deck.identity tells them apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Restriction bands read from the images: PHILIPPA on Owlform, Lightning bolt, Chain lightning, Spellbreaker, Paralyzing fetters, Blinding dust, Polymorphy and Backup plan; DIJKSTRA on Spymaster's ruse; ANY on Regicide, Cunning, Redanian plot and Do my bidding.

Polymorphy prints an ONGOING that unmatched-memory leaves out ("ONGOING: Philippa's move value is 5. Discard this card at the end of your turn if Philippa is not in a zone with an opposing fighter."); the overlay carries the printed text. Copies, type, value and boost of the 13 titles match unmatched-memory.

Hero card (read from the image): PHILIPPA, RANGED, START HEALTH 12, MOVE 2; special ability TWO STEPS AHEAD: 'At the end of your turn, you may draw until you have a hand of 4 cards.' Sidekick DIJKSTRA, MELEE, START HEALTH 6 (move 2 as the card prints it once for both). One Dijkstra.
